title: Tensor and unit coherence for arbitrary pulled pairings
statement: Let f:X→S, j:W→S, h:T→W be scheme morphisms [def-pc-scheme], with projections p_W,q_W,p_T,q_T and top map v [lem-sc-picard-canonical-base-change-comparisons]. Let M,N be O_X-modules, ev:M⊗N→O_X an arbitrary pairing, A,B O_W-modules, a:P_pW A→P_qW M and b:P_pW B→P_qW N arbitrary maps, and g:A⊗B→O_W. Write δ_k=picardTensorObjIso(k).hom and u_k=picardTensorUnitIso(k).hom [def-sc-picard-cup-product-map]. Assume P_pW(g) u_pW = δ_pW (a⊗b) δ_qW^(-1) P_qW(ev) u_qW. With C and D the explicitly constructed square and coefficient comparisons [lem-sc-picard-base-change-counit], the pullback along p_T of δ_h^(-1) P_h(g) u_h, followed by u_pT, equals δ_pT ((C_A P_v(a) D_M)⊗(C_B P_v(b) D_N)) δ_qT^(-1) P_qT(ev) u_qT. There are no adjunction or base-change maps in this conclusion. The exact formula is the lean.statement below.

proof.text: Apply picardPairing_comp to the bottom path p_T followed by h and the top path v followed by p_W, using pullback.lift_snd to identify the composites. The proved private tensor_pairing_paths cancels the top composition isomorphisms on both tensor factors. The definition of the square isomorphism identifies the resulting tensor map with C_A tensor C_B. This is the private pairing_square identity.

Cancel the epimorphism δ_pT inverse and apply pairing_square. Expand functorial mapping of compositions and substitute hg inside P_v. Cancel δ_pW inverse followed by δ_pW under the functor. Prove naturality of δ_v inverse by expanding its transport along picardTensorComparison, using naturality of that comparison, and monoidal μ naturality. This moves P_v(a tensor b) before δ_v inverse as P_v(a) tensor P_v(b).

Regroup the three mapped factors of e_W by functoriality. Apply picardPairing_comp to v followed by q_W and q_T, using pullback.lift_fst for their equality. The definition of D_M and D_N identifies the two resulting composition maps with the coefficient comparisons. The proved private tensor_pairing_coefficients combines the successive tensor maps into (C_A followed by P_v(a) followed by D_M) tensor (C_B followed by P_v(b) followed by D_N), giving exactly the conclusion. No adjunction-counit formula is applied.

lean.statement:
theorem picardPairing_pullback_coherence
    {X S W T : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) (j : W ⟶ S) (h : T ⟶ W)
    (M N : X.Modules) (ev : M ⊗ N ⟶ SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)
    (A B : W.Modules)
    (a : (tensorPullback (Limits.pullback.snd f j)).obj A ⟶
      (tensorPullback (Limits.pullback.fst f j)).obj M)
    (b : (tensorPullback (Limits.pullback.snd f j)).obj B ⟶
      (tensorPullback (Limits.pullback.fst f j)).obj N)
    (g : A ⊗ B ⟶ SheafOfModules.unit W.ringCatSheaf)
    (hg : (tensorPullback (Limits.pullback.snd f j)).map g ≫
        (picardTensorUnitIso (Limits.pullback.snd f j)).hom =
      (picardTensorObjIso (Limits.pullback.snd f j) A B).hom ≫ (a ⊗ₘ b) ≫
        (picardTensorObjIso (Limits.pullback.fst f j) M N).inv ≫
        (tensorPullback (Limits.pullback.fst f j)).map ev ≫
        (picardTensorUnitIso (Limits.pullback.fst f j)).hom) :
    (tensorPullback (Limits.pullback.snd f (h ≫ j))).map
      ((picardTensorObjIso h A B).inv ≫ (tensorPullback h).map g ≫
        (picardTensorUnitIso h).hom) ≫
      (picardTensorUnitIso (Limits.pullback.snd f (h ≫ j))).hom =
    (picardTensorObjIso (Limits.pullback.snd f (h ≫ j))
      ((tensorPullback h).obj A) ((tensorPullback h).obj B)).hom ≫
      (((picardBaseChangeSquareIso f j h A).hom ≫
          (tensorPullback (picardBaseChangeTop f j h)).map a ≫
          (picardBaseChangeCoefficientIso f j h M).hom) ⊗ₘ
        ((picardBaseChangeSquareIso f j h B).hom ≫
          (tensorPullback (picardBaseChangeTop f j h)).map b ≫
          (picardBaseChangeCoefficientIso f j h N).hom)) ≫
      (picardTensorObjIso (Limits.pullback.fst f (h ≫ j)) M N).inv ≫
      (tensorPullback (Limits.pullback.fst f (h ≫ j))).map ev ≫
      (picardTensorUnitIso (Limits.pullback.fst f (h ≫ j))).hom
